title: pvDeflectNormals
body:
## pvDeflectNormals

Tilts surface normals by a vector field: each new normal is normalize(N + ScaleFactor × V), where N is the input point normal (or the constant UserNormal) and V the selected point vector. The result is a point normal array DeflectedNormals set as the active normals; geometry is unchanged. It is a shading effect for visualizing a vector field on a surface (e.g. bump-like lighting from velocity), not a physical quantity.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Without input point normals ParaView warns and falls back to UserNormal; compute normals first (normals or pvGenerateSurfaceNormals) for curved surfaces.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `DeflectNormals`. Identity: `filters/DeflectNormals`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 3 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ScaleFactor` | Normal deflection factor. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `UseUserNormal` | Use a user specified normal instead of the existing point normals. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UserNormal` | Specify the user constant normal. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Vectors` | The value of this property contains the name of the vector array by which to deflect the dataset's normals. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
